brief: BOSS Odoo 20 pricing phase 1: CRM -> accepted quotation for all valid BOSS services, verified against supplier documents, deployed, ES/EN guide published at doc.bosscontinental.com/new

goals.title: G1 Sources
goals.objective: Source index and knowledge extraction with provenance (SharePoint NEW ODOO, O19, O20)
goals.evidence: .research/05 (9 Excel, all opened), 06 (MSC Jan/Feb/Sep, Hapag, CMA, notices), 07 (IRENEO MAD/BCN, 3 msg, WFS 2026), 08 doc site; missing docs listed (Hapag/CMA local charges, CFS, brokers, insurers)

goals.title: G2 Model fixes
goals.objective: Container size as condition, VAT treatment status blocking send/confirm, backend tariff permissions, history kept

goals.title: G3 Methods
goals.objective: Engine methods max-of-bases, brackets, percentage, time-based estimate vs actual; manual/offer costs
goals.evidence: engine methods per_unit/max_of_bases/brackets/percent/time (positional, relative, whole stay; deduct/threshold); manual cost on manual/not_ready lines

goals.title: G4 Catalogue
goals.objective: Every service mapped to its source, legacy codes kept, method per service, ES/EN help

goals.title: G5 Samples
goals.objective: Reference samples from supplier documents (THC, ALM, others), idempotent loader, independent expected results in tests

goals.title: G6 UI cycle
goals.objective: CRM to accepted quotation verified in the UI on an isolated DB, incl. missing definition and return; screenshots

goals.title: G7 Deploy
goals.objective: Modules deployed to the Odoo 20 env after identity check; commits

goals.title: G8 Guide
goals.objective: ES/EN guide built, old guide archived dated, new guide published and verified
